metadata.title: Phase 1A.2b2-R1 — terminal-effect source closure
metadata.sourceMethod: Additive deterministic reconciliation of the accepted b2 chain census with bounded route/method AST traces and source references. No application behavior or predecessor evidence was changed.
generatedFrom: bounded AST trace captured outside the repository

gate.interpretation: All 394 accepted chain records receive explicit normalized source classifications. This does not establish runtime response behavior, successful persistence, provider success, authorization correctness, organization isolation, or audit completeness. The 154 chains not previously terminally observed remain unestablished; runtime readiness is not advanced.

normalizationRules.serverTarget: HTTP request path/method is known from source even when local route/method is absent or unconfirmed; those mapping states are explicit. Non-HTTP action/provider identity is retained without inferring its implementation.
normalizationRules.dataEffect: The accepted b2 assessment is normalized without promoting unresolved effects. NOT_ESTABLISHED and NOT_TRACED are explicit evidence states. Zero UNKNOWN labels means each row has a named evidence state, not that every effect was resolved.
normalizationRules.requestResponse: Request source facts are retained from b2. Runtime responses are not observed; response proof remains false.
normalizationRules.authorizationOrganizationAudit: Bounded trace call evidence only. Presence is not correctness/completeness; no captured evidence is not proof of absence.
